question: Who rules the Kataha Rudras in the lower cosmology described here?
premises: The Kataha Rudras are devoted to desire.
He is depicted mounted on a vessel within the waters, reeling from drink.
inference: The lower cosmological order is personified through Ananta as ruler of the desire-bound Kataha Rudras.
plain_english: The ruler of the Kataha Rudras, who are devoted to desire, is Ananta; he is mounted on a vessel within the waters, reeling from drinking liquor.
